title: Booking setup — question by question, with the Assistant
body:
On this one page you set up everything guests need in order to book: the rooms,
the prices, the periods and the booking rules. You do not need to know which menu holds what — the
page asks, you answer. If something is unclear, the **„Assistant”** explains it.

How to get there: on the **Modules** tab, open the Online booking screen. Below the calendar and the requests
is the **„Set up booking”** (Booking setup) card — the **„I'll set it up question by question”** button opens
this page. If the Online booking module is not switched on, the page does not open.

![Screenshot: the Booking setup page on a phone — the finished parts with their answers, the questions in the open part](assets/hu/screen.png)

## How do you work through it?

The page has six parts, in this order: **„Property and rooms”**, **„Pricing”**,
**„Booking rules”**, **„What the guest sees”**, **„Notification”** and **„Try it”**.
Next to each part a tag tells you where you are: **„Done”**, **„Not filled in yet”**,
or how many questions are missing or how many obstacles it contains. The tag of the **„Try it”** part
is **„Not tried yet”** until a test booking has run on this page — when you open the part,
it runs one by itself. Below the title you can also see how many of the six parts are done.

1. Tap a part: it opens and you see its questions. Only one part is open at a time.
2. Answer the questions. For closed parts your answers are shown on one line, so later you can
   see at a glance what you have set.
3. At the bottom of the part, the **„Save and continue”** button saves your answer and opens the next part.
   If you tap another part in the meantime, what you have typed so far is saved anyway.
4. If something is wrong (for example the shortest booking is longer than the longest), a red line
   above the button tells you what to fix — in that case nothing changes.

You use the same page for later changes too: if you want to raise your prices in a year, you do it right here.

## Property and rooms

First we ask how you let your property: **„As a whole, as one unit”** (As a whole, as one unit — the whole house
to one group of guests at a time) or **„Per room”**. By room, a guest can book one or
more rooms in a single request, even all of them: someone who wants the whole house selects every room and
pays the rooms' prices — so you do not need to give a separate price for the whole house. You
confirm or decline a multi-room request as one on the Bookings tab.
If you only let the house as a whole but would like to show your rooms, choose the first option: then only the whole
house can be booked, and we only ask for a price for the house.

Then you give the room names and the capacity; you add a new room with the **„+ Another room”** button.
The capacity is also the upper limit for bookings: the guest cannot enter more people than this, and the system
does not accept a request for more ("At most 4 guests can book here."). Where you leave it empty, there is no limit.
You cannot delete a room here: you do that on the **„Rooms”** screen, because there you can see what
disappears with it (calendar, prices, earlier bookings).

## Prices and periods

- First you choose what the price is for: **„Per night”**, **„Per person, per night”**
  or **„For the entire stay”**.
- Then the base price for each room. If you do not want to give a price, tick the **„I won't set a price — the guest requests a quote and I send the price”** line.
- You add a period with a different price (for example high season) with the **„+ New season”** line: name, start and end
  day (month-day, for example 06-15), price and, if needed, the minimum number of nights that can be booked.
  The **„Add”** button saves it immediately; with several rooms the **„Add it to every room”** button
  adds it to each of them.
- If you have periods, we also ask whether you let the property outside those periods.

You can enter year-specific prices and the order of the periods on the **„Prices and periods”** screen.

## Booking rules

- **How many nights can be booked?** — the shortest (1–30) and the longest (1–365) booking. If you gave a
  period its own "minimum" value, that one applies within that period.
- **How far ahead can guests book?** — how many months ahead the calendar opens (1–24), and the earliest
  number of days from now the guest can arrive (0 = even today).

## What the guest sees

- **Do you charge tourist tax?** — there are three answers. **„Yes”**: you enter the amount (per person / per night), and the
  guest sees it calculated, on a separate line. **„No tourist tax”**: your website does not mention it at all.
  **„I'm not sure yet”** (I don't know yet): the guest only sees that tax is payable on site, without an amount —
  we do not invent a number for you. The guest pays the tax on site; we do not add it to the total.
  Guests under 18 are exempt from the tax: when booking, the guest always states how many of them are children
  ("Of whom children"), we do not charge for them, and a sentence tells the guest so.
- **What is included in the price?** — a short line below the total (for example: cleaning, bed linen, breakfast).
  It is optional; if you leave it empty, the line is not shown.

## Notification

- **Where should we send booking requests?** — every request goes here by email; you can give several addresses
  separated by commas. If you leave it empty, we send them to your account's address. If an address is not an email address, the page tells you and does not save.
- Below it you set after how many hours a request expires by itself if you do not answer. The guest then
  gets a notification to look for accommodation elsewhere. 0 = the request never expires.

## If the page reports an obstacle

In the **„Try it”** part the page lists the settings that prevent the guest from booking, or from booking
properly. A **yellow** box means the guest CANNOT book — for example if you only let a room
during periods but have no periods, or if a period's minimum stay is longer than the
longest booking. In that case a red tag next to the affected part says how many obstacles it contains.
A **grey** box is only a warning: for example a room has no price, so the guest sends a request without a total,
and you reply with a price offer. The **„Fix it”** button next to the box takes you to the question.

At the bottom of the page the **„Done — guests can book”** button cannot be pressed while there is a yellow obstacle
or a mandatory question is still unanswered. When it can be pressed, it takes you to the Online booking screen.

## Try it out

Enter an imaginary booking: room, arrival, number of nights and guests, and how many of them are
children (**„Of which children”** — Of whom children). If you also offer board, you can try the surcharge with the **„Meals”** (Board) field.
The page shows what the guest would see: the price of the stay, the board lines and the total, the
tourist tax, or why the guest could not send it. It uses the same rules as your website's booking form.
This is only a test: nothing is sent, and no days are reserved.

## The Assistant

On a phone, the **„Ask the Assistant”** bar at the bottom of the page opens it; on a computer the
Assistant is on the right-hand side of the page. Type your question, or tap a suggested question.

![Screenshot: the Assistant on a phone, opened from the bottom bar](assets/hu/segito.png)

- The Assistant **explains** the settings and, if needed, **takes you** with a button to the question
  where you can enter it.
- **It does not type in or change anything** — the decision and the input are yours.
- It only talks about the booking setup. For other questions, use the Help or contact us.
- The answers are written by artificial intelligence. If something does not match what you see on screen,
  trust the screen.
- It answers at most 40 questions a day; after that you can continue the next day.

## Advanced settings

The **„Advanced settings”** link at the top of the page opens the earlier screens: **„Rooms”** (Rooms —
photos, description, amenities, deleting a room), **„Prices and periods”** (Prices and periods — this is also where you set board —
breakfast, half board — the surcharges and the children's price) and **„Online booking”** (Online booking —
calendar, other sites' calendars and the earlier setup form). They show the same data as this
page — if you change something there, you see it here too.
